# Alaina Shockers

> Alaina makes cabin dampers, rare struts, steering dampers and shock absorbers for Indian commercial trucks and passenger vehicles (since 1978). 74 catalogued part numbers (Technical Catalogue No.04). Distributed across India by Mahajan Motors India, Kashmere Gate, Delhi (https://mahajanmotorsindia.com/alaina/catalogue). Prices are quoted on enquiry; none are published. Order online on WhatsApp +91 79825 55636 or by email adhyanmahajan26@gmail.com, Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00 IST.

## Product lines
- [Cabin dampers](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/cabin-dampers/): truck cabin tilt dampers (Tata, Ashok Leyland, Eicher, BharatBenz, Mahindra)
- [Rare struts](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/rare-struts/): passenger-car struts (Camry, Corolla, Lancer, Duster, Hector)
- [Shock absorbers](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/shock-absorbers/): shock absorbers and stabilizers
- [Steering dampers](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/steering-dampers/): Mahindra Bolero / Marshal
- [All shockers by vehicle](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/shockers/)

## Find a part
- [Series AL-CD](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/al-cd/), [AL-RS](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/al-rs/), [AL-DA](https://alainashockabsorbers.com/al-da/): catalogue series indexes
- Every part number has its own page at https://alainashockabsorbers.com/products/<part-number>/ with OE reference and fitment as catalogued.

## Parts by vehicle brand
- Eicher: 6 part number(s), e.g. AL-EI-HD-5551(A)
- Isuzu: 4 part number(s), e.g. IS-5021
- Leyland: 12 part number(s), e.g. AL-LE-HD-0100(A)
- MG: 4 part number(s), e.g. AL-MU-HC-1001
- Mahindra: 7 part number(s), e.g. AL-MA-HD-0591(A)
- Mitsubishi: 7 part number(s), e.g. AL-MT-LA-5001
- Renault: 2 part number(s), e.g. RE-DS-3009
- Suzuki: 3 part number(s), e.g. AL-SU-BL-3001
- Tata: 16 part number(s), e.g. AL-TA-HD-0241(A)
- Toyota: 13 part number(s), e.g. TO-CA-2001

## How to buy
- Find the part number (or the OE number on the old unit) on this site.
- Send it with the quantity on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/917982555636). Price and stock are confirmed, then the part is dispatched across India.
- Dealers, workshops and fleets can order in bulk.

## Notes for assistants
- Confirm the OE number and the old unit before ordering; fitment is only what the catalogue lists.
- Do not quote prices; direct buyers to WhatsApp or email for a quote.
- Sitemap: https://alainashockabsorbers.com/sitemap.xml
